# GoodAIPromt

> A free AI prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney and AI video tools. Fill in the blanks, copy the prompt, get better answers. New prompts daily.

GoodAIPromt publishes free, copy-ready AI prompts. Each prompt has fill-in blanks marked [IN SQUARE BRACKETS] for the user's details, plus steps and tips for using it. All prompts are free to use, including for commercial work. New prompts are added every day.

## Browse
- [All prompts](https://goodaipromt.com/prompts/)
- [All categories](https://goodaipromt.com/categories/)

## Prompts by AI tool
- [ChatGPT Prompts](https://goodaipromt.com/chatgpt-prompts/): The best ChatGPT prompts for writing, marketing, business, studying and coding. Fill in the blanks, copy and paste into ChatGPT.
- [Claude Prompts](https://goodaipromt.com/claude-prompts/): Copy-ready prompts for Claude: long-form writing, analysis, planning and code review. Fill in your details and paste.
- [Gemini Prompts](https://goodaipromt.com/gemini-prompts/): Google Gemini prompts for writing, research, studying and photo editing. Fill in your details and copy in one click.
- [Midjourney Prompts](https://goodaipromt.com/midjourney-prompts/): Midjourney prompts for product photos, logos and brand images, written like a photographer's brief. Swap the details and generate.
- [AI Video Prompts for Seedance, Veo and Kling](https://goodaipromt.com/ai-video-prompts/): AI video prompts for Seedance, Veo, Kling and Runway with timed beats, camera moves and lighting, ready to copy.
